rules: Manifest schema_version is exactly 1 and bundle_id is ch11-capstone-three-items.
Every input path is normalized, repository-relative, unique, and contains no '..'.
Every input role is data or shapes and every declared digest is lowercase SHA-256.
The bundle contains at least one data input and exactly one shapes input.
The bundle digest is calculated over canonical sorted path/role/sha256 entries.
Every input hash and the manifest hash are rechecked after validation.
Draft/Planned/NotRun/NotPerformed/Candidate denotes a registered boundary, not proof.
Knowledge-model conformance is not ISO verification, confirmation review, engineering sufficiency, or release authorization.
status: native_declarative_boundary; executable bundle check blocked by missing inputs
